name: Cambodia Cubing Championship 2019

venue.name: [Cambodia-Japan Cooperation Center](http://www.cjcc.edu.kh/site/index.php/en/)
venue.address: Russian Confederation Blvd., Tuol Kork, Pnom Penh, Cambodia

information: This is the first-ever national cubing championship of Cambodia. We also have a Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. [Khmer Top Cuber](https://www.facebook.com/groups/KhmerCuber/). You can join the group to stay updated with upcoming competitions in the area.
